name: shared-rules
description: Shared Claude rules for cloud sessions and fresh containers - a SessionStart hook loads one public rules repo (github.com/bogheorghiu/claude-rules) into context, so the same rules apply where no local ~/.claude/rules install exists.

rules_repo.title: Rules repository
rules_repo.description: Git URL of the rules repo to load. Rules are the .md files under its rules/ folder.

update_mode.title: Rule updates
update_mode.description: ask: new or changed rules wait until you approve them in a session. auto: they load as soon as they are published.
